turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hello, this is Asha, a virtual assistant from Suraksha Health Insurance, calling about the health insurance enquiry you submitted. This call is recorded for quality and training purposes. Is this a good time to talk for about five minutes?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: First, who would you like to cover: just yourself, or also your spouse, children or parents?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: What is the age of the eldest person to be covered?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Which city do you live in?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Before that, how does cashless treatment work at the hospital?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hospital bills covered, cashless at 6,500+ network hospitals. Which city do you live in?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Does anyone to be covered have an existing medical condition, such as diabetes, blood pressure, thyroid or asthma?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Do you have any existing health insurance, including cover from your employer?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: No, I don't have any insurance

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Last one: which cover amount are you looking at, 5, 10, 15 or 25 lakh rupees? You can also say not sure.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you, that's everything I need. You're eligible to apply for Family Shield. Please note: illnesses are covered after a 30-day waiting period, and pre-existing diseases after 3 years. The indicative annual premium for one member aged 26-35 with 10 lakh cover is Rs 9,600. I'll send you a written quote by email or WhatsApp within 15 minutes, and an advisor will confirm the final premium. Thank you for your time, goodbye.
